title: Directorate General of Mines and Minerals Service Rules 2002

sections.shortTitle: Directorate General of Mines and Minerals Service Rules 2002
sections.section: RULES - Directorate General of Mines and Minerals Service Rules 2002
sections.description:
DIRECTORATE GENERAL OF MINES AND
DIRECTORATE GENERAL OF MINES
AND
MINERALS SERVICE RULES, 2002
(Amendment of Schedule)
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, Part I,
17th August, 2011]
No.SOR-III(S&GAD)1-18/2006,
dated 1-1-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 23 of the
Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of 1974), the Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to direct that in the Directorate General of Mines and Minerals Service
Rules, 2002, the following further amendments shall be made:--
In
the said rules, in the Schedule:--
(i) for
the existing entry in column No.7, the following shall be substituted:--
"By
promotion through selection no merits from amongst the Directors in the
Directorate General of Mines and Minerals with at least seventeen years service
in (BS-17) and above, and in case of initial recruitment in the Directorate
General of Mines and Minerals:--
(a) in
(BS-18), at least twelve years service in (BS-18) and above; and
(b) in
(BS-19), at least five years service;
or
by
posting."
(ii) the
entries in columns Nos.5, 8 and 9 shall omitted.
